text:
lia: Quick q — for vuln triage we sometimes need to pull full request traces from SIEM (k8s events + auth logs). Who can approve short-lived exports (<24h) that require KMS unwrap? We should avoid manual CMK unwraps for each request. Thoughts?

alex_m: +1 we need a playbook. Current flow is ticket in #sec-requests, manual IAM grant, ops does unwrap, send S3 link. Slow and noisy.

priya: We should prefer a proxy-unseal service that mints timeboxed ephemeral creds scoped to a narrow role. Gate by OPA policy and require a justification string recorded in the audit event. That way we never give long-lived unwrap rights.

samir: Also make redaction mandatory pre-export. For vuln triage we usually only need trace + headers; PII should be masked. If DLP flags, block export and escalate.

maria_s: Sketch of an approval/playbook: 
1) Submit new ticket using template below (include CVSS, incident id, justification, time window)
2) Auto-check rules: if tag=triage AND CVSS>=7 => allow scoped auto-approval for "siem-temp-reader" for 12h; otherwise require manual SOC approval
3) Proxy-unseal service (no CMK key material to operators) mints STS tokens and records unwrap event to audit log with ticket id
4) Export job runs redaction pipeline and writes to timeboxed S3 bucket with SSE-KMS using a key that only the proxy can unwrap
5) Audit event emitted with exporter/user/ticket link; ticket auto-updated with signed URL
6) On ticket close or TTL expiry revoke role and log revocation

lia: can you paste the ticket template we can start with?

maria_s: ```
REQUEST TYPE: SIEM EXPORT (timeboxed)
REQUESTER: <name/email>
TICKET ID: <link>
JUSTIFICATION: <why needed; link to vuln/incident>
SCOPE: services/namespaces/days of logs
CVSS or Severity: <score>
TIME WINDOW REQUESTED: <start/end; max 24h>
REDACTION REQUIRED: yes/no (default yes)
APPROVAL: auto/manual (auto if triage+CVSS>=7)
SENSITIVE DATA EXPECTED: yes/no

Notes: include any fastpath reason and list reviewers.
```

alex_m: For RBAC, create a dedicated role: "siem-temp-reader" with only s3:GetObject + read-only SIEM query perms. Use session tags for ticket:id and approver. TTL max 12h; require MFA for escalations >12h. Also add a KMS key policy that allows Decrypt only to the proxy service principal and to the CMK admin role for emergency audits.

priya: Implementation roadmap: 
- PR 1: IAM role + KMS key policy changes (alex)
- PR 2: proxy-unseal lambda + OPA rules + audit event schema (priya)
- PR 3: redaction pipeline hook + DLP check (samir)
- PR 4: ticket template + automation integration (maria)

alex_m: I filed initial IAM PR draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/472 — needs review from @priya and @maria_s.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Any auto-approved export must notify #oncall and create an ephemeral audit entry with ticket id.

lia: ok — who owns drafting the playbook text for runbook? I'll add the incident-runbook entry once we have wording.

maria_s: I can write the playbook and add examples of objectionable fields to scrub. Will ping for review.

alex_m: I'll take the IAM PR and add the session-tagging bits.

priya: I'll start the proxy-unseal PoC this week. Will post architecture diagram in a follow-up thread.

samir: I'll add redaction rules and DLP integration tests to the pipeline.

deploy-bot: Deploy queue updated: infra/iam PR 472 queued for 2 reviewers.

lia: sweet. Let's aim to have a beta flow for triage exports in 2 weeks. If anyone has objections to auto-approval rule (triage+CVSS>=7) speak now or file on the PR. :thumbsup:

maria_s: :thumbsup:
